title: MSFS Live Traffic Is BACK! FSLTL x Navigraph Setup Guide
description:
The virtual skies are no longer empty! After FlightRadar24 changed its API terms and left our flight simulator worlds feeling like ghost towns, a massive official solution has arrived. Navigraph and FlightRadar24 have officially teamed up to bring legitimate, high-fidelity, real-world live traffic back to Microsoft Flight Simulator—integrated directly into a brand new version of FSLTL (v2.0+).

If you are an active Navigraph Unlimited subscriber, this game-changing live traffic data feed is completely bundled into your existing subscription at absolutely no extra cost.

However, you have to set this up correctly! In this video, we go step-by-step through the FlyByWire installer, look at the brand-new web interface configuration layout, and fix the essential in-game MSFS traffic settings. If you don't tweak one specific setting inside the simulator, you'll end up with duplicate, glitching aircraft colliding on your taxiways.

We wrap up with a live demonstration at a bustling Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (EHAM) to see the injector in action, checking out injected KLM cargo 747s, Air China, Qatar, and more.

What do you think about this new subscription integration for live traffic data? Let me know your thoughts in the comments below!
